name: Reply Desk
tagline: Drafts customer replies for local service businesses without inventing a fact
description: Paste a customer email, text or public review and it drafts a reply a local service business can send as-is. It is barred from inventing prices, dates or promises, so a draft reflects only what you have told it. You review and send everything; nothing goes out on its own.
author: lonzom10
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
